## Install

- **Windows:** download `Refall-windows-x64.exe` and run it (no install needed)
- **Linux:** download the AppImage for your machine (`x86_64` or `aarch64`), make it executable (`chmod +x`) and run it
- **macOS:** open the `.dmg` for your Mac (`arm64`: Apple silicon, `x64`: Intel) and drag Refall to Applications
  - the first time, right-click it and choose **Open** (it is not signed by an Apple developer)
- **Anywhere with Python:** `uvx refall` (or `pipx install refall`), see [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/refall/)
- **In your browser:** [gregwar.com/refall](https://gregwar.com/refall)
